new_findings.finding: The three submitted short links, followed on 2026-11-16, redirect to their Amazon destinations with attribution query parameters attached: btn_ref=srctok-<hex> and channelId=704 on every one of the three. No Associates 'tag' parameter was observed on any of the three destinations. The meaning of the srctok and channelId parameters is NOT established from any official source (unverified); what is verifiable is that they are not an Associates tag, and Participation Requirements 2(b) requires the tag parameter on every link an Associate places to an Amazon Site. Combined with the Commission Income Limitations clause (claims from two programs on the same traffic), links that carry third-party attribution but no Associates tag cannot earn Associates commission for this site's owner and may credit some other party. Owner decisions: (1) who minted these links; (2) whether they are intended as Associates links at all; (3) if yes, replace them with tagged Special Links minted inside Associates Central (decision board proposal D-15).

The redirects observed on 2026-11-16 reproduce the destinations recorded by sessions 7f84fea4, ab3ed329, 5b425c74 and 59d84c55 (same three ASINs), while the listing titles observed today match the titles already recorded in data/i2/catalog.json character for character. Corroborates the 4f83-F-01 / 5b42-F-01 drift notes: destinations are stable across sessions, titles can drift over time.
